(2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a skin treatment being performed. A hand in a white glove holds a medical laser device over a person's face, which is partially visible. Red light pulses from the device onto the skin. (3) The camera returns to the female speaker on the sofa. She continues her explanation, shifting her posture and gesturing with both hands.
